front.title: A Post-Quantum Bootstrap Profile for WireGuard

abstract.t:
This document specifies a post-quantum bootstrap profile for WireGuard. A mutually authenticated ML-KEM-768 and ML-DSA exchange derives a 32-octet preshared key (PSK), verifies key possession, and binds it to configured endpoint identities and WireGuard public keys. The resulting key is installed through the ordinary WireGuard PresharedKey configuration field.
The profile defines canonical binary control records carried over mutually authenticated TLS 1.3 on TCP, with explicit message lengths, freshness, state transitions, and failure processing. Bootstrap carries the post-quantum contribution into the WireGuard PSK input; it is therefore part of the post-quantum provisioning mechanism. The native WireGuard Noise handshake and transport packet format are unchanged.
This Internet-Draft is a proposal for Standards Track publication. It requests an ALPN protocol identifier for the bootstrap carrier. The request is pending; this document does not assign a native WireGuard packet type or a service port.
